_readme: Voice mapping for pilot story narration (generate_story_audio.py). Xia's decided narration voice (2026-08): the Buju child voice from jubu_backend (ENG-337), used for all three tellers; storyteller_tale is slightly slower for a cozier pace. To try alternatives later: `python scripts/generate_story_audio.py --audition <voice_id>…`, listen in story_definitions/preview/audio_auditions/, then swap voice_id per teller here and regenerate with --force.
